sentences.text: Coram :
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava

--------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Diwakar Jha, Advocate.
For the State : Mr. R.R.R. Das, A.P.P.

For the Opp. Party No. 2 : Mr. Laln Kr. Singh, Advocate.
---------
th Order No. 4/Dated: 10 November, 2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 2158/2019, wherein cognizance under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act has been taken, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per complaint allegation is that the petitioner was married with the complainant on 13.07.2016.
It is alleged that just after marriage, there was demand of Rs. 2 lakhs cash and due to non- fulfillment of dowry, she has been subjected to cruelty and torture.
She was compelled to leave her matrimonial home on 02.09.2019.

It is alleged that on the same day itself, all the accused persons including the petitioner came to the parental home of the complainant and started quarreled and forcibly tried to bring the complainant with them to join the matrimonial home.
It is alleged that due to intervention of family members and other local villagers, complainant was saved.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that there is false allegation against the petitioner,
rather true fact is that the complainant herself left her matrimonial home due to bad habit of the petitioner i.e. addiction of drinking and petitioner has never demanded dowry and additional dowry from the complainant or her father.
It is further submitted that there is no specific allegation against the petitioner and all the allegations are general and omnibus in nature.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the informant has also opposed the prayer for bail and has submitted that there is direct allegation of demand of dowry and torture against the petitioner.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned SDJM, Giridih in connection with Complaint Case No. 2158 of 2019 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Sunil/
